description: MoPlan weights. Download with: hf download yrlyrl/MoPlan --revision b0db0e367f6508977ec9eca693ae3888c52be2dd --local-dir $MOPLAN_WEIGHTS

layout.stage1/: Stage-1 motion planner checkpoint (step 6000) + the direct-objective prior latent
layout.stage2/high/: final Stage-2 generator, high-noise expert (LoRA + motion adapter)
layout.stage2/low/: final Stage-2 generator, low-noise expert (LoRA + motion adapter)

base_model.note: not redistributed; Stage-1 uses its transformer/ (high-noise expert), vae/, text_encoder/, tokenizer/

files.content: Stage-1 trainable backend parameters (LoRA r32 on the Wan2.2 high-noise expert, new input patch embedding, output layer)
training state of the checkpoint, unchanged; the loader reads decoder_config and expert from it

the checkpoint's resolved training config with every data path replaced by a relative placeholder and paths.wan_model left empty (set by --set paths.wan_model=... or $WAN_MODEL_DIR); all values the loader and sampler read are unchanged
completion marker of the training checkpoint, unchanged (provenance only; it also lists optimizer/scheduler/RNG files that are not released, and the sha256 of the original config)
{'prior_latent': fp16 [16, 32, 32]}: the init latent of the direct Stage-1 objective (slot 0 of a zero-motion flow-latent cache entry); pass with --prior-latent
LoRA r32 / alpha 32 of the high-noise expert (800 tensors, peft key names)
motion adapter of the high-noise expert (ExtendedOnlyFlowAdapter, 20 + 7 condition channels)
LoRA r32 / alpha 32 of the low-noise expert (800 tensors, peft key names)
motion adapter of the low-noise expert (ExtendedOnlyFlowAdapter, 20 + 7 condition channels)

not_released: Stage-1 optimizer.pt / scheduler.pt / rng_state.pt (not needed for inference)
Stage-2 trainer_state.json / train_overrides.json (training bookkeeping, not read by inference)
